description: This file defines the SocialAuth class that handles OAuth and OpenID authentication for various social media providers such as Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, Google, and OpenID. It manages user data retrieval, token handling, and login integration with the Goteo application.

classes.name: Goteo\Library\OAuth\SocialAuth
classes.description: Handles OAuth/OpenID social authentication for multiple providers, retrieves user data, manages tokens, and integrates login into the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SocialAuth object with the specified provider and configures the callback URL based on application settings.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Main method to initiate authentication process based on the provider, redirecting to OAuth or OpenID authentication flows.

methods.name: authenticateOpenid
methods.description: Handles the OpenID authentication flow, including identity verification and user data extraction.

methods.name: authenticateTwitter
methods.description: Handles the OAuth 1.0a flow for Twitter, requesting authorization and retrieving user data upon callback.

methods.name: authenticateGoogle
methods.description: Handles OAuth 2.0 authentication with Google, retrieving user info upon successful authorization.

methods.name: authenticateFacebook
methods.description: Handles OAuth 2.0 authentication with Facebook, retrieving user profile information.

methods.name: authenticateLinkedin
methods.description: Handles OAuth 2.0 authentication with LinkedIn, retrieving user profile and picture data.

methods.name: goteoLogin
methods.description: Logs the user into Goteo platform if possible, updating user data and tokens based on social provider info.

methods.name: saveTokensToUser
methods.description: Stores OAuth tokens associated with a user in the database.
